# Lista Kauffmann

> Free, open map and static JSON data of Stolpersteine (Germany and other European countries, see the app for the full list) and victims of the Shoah: 181,669 people records across 7 licence families, each with its sources. Cada placa, cada nombre, cada historia. Nunca olvidar. · Jede Platte, jeder Name, jede Geschichte. · Every plaque, every name, every story.

Este archivo es informativo y NO tiene valor jurídico propio: lo que obliga son las licencias de los datos. (This file is informational and has no legal force: the data licences bind.)

Personal, non-commercial; no third-party trackers (only our own cookieless visit counter). Never invent data: if a field is missing in a record, say it is not recorded. Data date: 2026-11-21.

## Start here

- [Full agent guide (llms-full.txt)](https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/llms-full.txt): step-by-step how to find a person, normalisation code, citation template, licences.
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/openapi.json): every static endpoint with schemas and examples.
- [API catalogue](https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/index.json): licence families, endpoints, usage rules.
- [Person record JSON Schema](https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/schema/person.schema.json)
- [Statistics](https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/stats.json)

## Find a person (static files, GET only)

- [Search manifest – cc-by (CC-BY)](https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/cc-by/find/index.json): 228 people. By name: `https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/cc-by/find/name/<prefix>.json`; by place: `find/city/index.json` → `find/city/<cc>/<slug>.json`; by year: `find/year/birth|death/<yyyy>.json`.
- [Search manifest – cc-by-4 (CC-BY-4.0)](https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/cc-by-4/find/index.json): 111 people. By name: `https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/cc-by-4/find/name/<prefix>.json`; by place: `find/city/index.json` → `find/city/<cc>/<slug>.json`; by year: `find/year/birth|death/<yyyy>.json`.
- [Search manifest – cc0 (CC0-1.0)](https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/cc0/find/index.json): 118,254 people. By name: `https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/cc0/find/name/<prefix>.json`; by place: `find/city/index.json` → `find/city/<cc>/<slug>.json`; by year: `find/year/birth|death/<yyyy>.json`.
- [Search manifest – cc0-opendata (CC0-1.0)](https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/cc0-opendata/find/index.json): 196 people. By name: `https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/cc0-opendata/find/name/<prefix>.json`; by place: `find/city/index.json` → `find/city/<cc>/<slug>.json`; by year: `find/year/birth|death/<yyyy>.json`.
- [Search manifest – dl-de-by (dl-de/by-2-0)](https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/dl-de-by/find/index.json): 0 people. By name: `https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/dl-de-by/find/name/<prefix>.json`; by place: `find/city/index.json` → `find/city/<cc>/<slug>.json`; by year: `find/year/birth|death/<yyyy>.json`.
- [Search manifest – dl-de-zero (dl-de/zero-2-0)](https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/dl-de-zero/find/index.json): 361 people. By name: `https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/dl-de-zero/find/name/<prefix>.json`; by place: `find/city/index.json` → `find/city/<cc>/<slug>.json`; by year: `find/year/birth|death/<yyyy>.json`.
- [Search manifest – odbl (ODbL-1.0)](https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/odbl/find/index.json): 62,519 people. By name: `https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/odbl/find/name/<prefix>.json`; by place: `find/city/index.json` → `find/city/<cc>/<slug>.json`; by year: `find/year/birth|death/<yyyy>.json`.

1. Normalise a word of the name with fold(): lowercase, ß→ss, strip accents, ä→a ö→o ü→u, ae/oe/ue→a/o/u, keep a-z0-9 (Müller → `muller`).
2. Try the first 6, 5, … 1 letters of that key (pad short keys with `_`) until a prefix exists in `name.prefixes` of the manifest.
3. Open `find/name/<prefix>.json`, keep rows whose first value (token) starts with your key, compare full name and years. Hyphenated names: split fold() on spaces and search each token. Particles/titles (von, van, de, zu, Dr., Prof.…) and words of 1 letter are not indexed: search the surname.
4. Each row ends with `people_prefix`: open `<family>/people/by-surname/<people_prefix>.json` and take the person whose `id` equals the row id. That record holds `sources[]` (original URLs), `links[]`, memorials and inscription.
5. The same person can exist in more than one family (linked by Wikidata Qid in `identifiers.wikidata`); check each and keep each licence separate.

## Cite

- Always cite: **Lista Kauffmann** + the person link + the original source from `sources[].url` + data date + licence.
- Person link (opens it in the map): cc0 → `https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/#p=<id>`; all memorial families (odbl, cc-by, cc-by-4, dl-de-zero, dl-de-by, cc0-opendata) → `https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/#s=<memorials[0].memorial_id>` (the plaque). Machine-readable record: `https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/api/v1/<family>/people/by-surname/<people_prefix>.json` (object with that id).
- Template: `{name} ({birth}–{death}). Lista Kauffmann, ficha {id}, {permalink}. Fuente: {source_url}. Datos de {generated}. Licencia {license} ({attribution}).`
- Use only fields present in the record. Do not add biography, family, motives or dates that are not in `sources[]`.

## Licences

- `api/v1/odbl/`, `data/search/`, `data/stones.json`: ODbL 1.0, derived from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright) + Wikidata (CC0). Share-alike and attribution if you redistribute the database or a substantial extract.
- `api/v1/cc0/`: Wikidata only, CC0 1.0.
- `api/v1/cc-by/`, `data/berlin-added-*.json`: Creative Commons Attribution (cc-by), Koordinierungsstelle Stolpersteine Berlin, https://daten.berlin.de/datensaetze/liste-der-stolpersteine-berlin. The catalogue lists license_id cc-by; the version (3.0 vs 4.0) is not stated on the dataset page. Names, address, birth year and coordinates only; biographies from stolpersteine-berlin.de are never copied.
- `api/v1/cc-by-4/`, `data/memmingen-added-*.json`, `data/firenze-added-*.json`: CC BY 4.0 (Stadt Memmingen / open.bydata; Comune di Firenze / dati.toscana.it).
- `api/v1/dl-de-zero/`, `data/koeln-added-*.json`, `data/moenchengladbach-added-*.json`, `data/krefeld-added-*.json`, `data/viersen-added-*.json`, `data/moers-added-*.json`, `data/xanten-added-*.json`, `data/erkrath-added-*.json`, `data/dormagen-added-*.json`: Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero – Version 2.0 (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). No prose biographies copied.
- `api/v1/dl-de-by/`, `data/dresden-added-*.json`: Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung – Version 2.0 (`Datenquelle: Landeshauptstadt Dresden, dl-de/by-2-0, opendata.dresden.de`).
- `api/v1/cc0-opendata/`, `data/denhaag-added-*.json`, `data/monza-added-*.json`, `data/grevenbroich-added-*.json`: CC0 1.0 municipal open datasets (kept separate from Wikidata `api/v1/cc0/`).
- Wikipedia text is never copied (links only; CC BY-SA 4.0).
- Documentation and catalogues: CC0 1.0. Each data file states its licence in `meta.license`.
- [Complete ODbL plaque database](https://roquena71-a11y.github.io/kauffmann-list/data/stones.json): transcription of public street memorials from OSM + Wikidata, not person records, and not mixed with the municipal additions.

## Scope and care

La API de personas (api/v1) excluye a las personas posiblemente vivas (sin indicio de muerte y nacidas hace menos de 110 años, o sin año) y quita los enlaces a fichas de registro de posibles supervivientes nacidos desde 1916. data/search/ y data/stones.json NO son fichas de personas: son transcripciones de placas públicas (memoriales físicos en la calle) e incluyen TODAS las placas, también las de personas posiblemente vivas. data/search/ solo contiene nombre tal como figura en la placa, dirección, coordenadas y año; data/stones.json es la base de placas completa (OpenStreetMap + Wikidata) con la inscripción y las etiquetas y enlaces que esas placas tienen en OSM/Wikidata. Las placas añadidas de listas municipales abiertas están en data/*-added-*.json (Berlín CC BY; Köln, Mönchengladbach, Krefeld, Viersen, Moers GDI-DE, Xanten, Erkrath y Dormagen bajo dl-de/zero-2-0; Dresden bajo dl-de/by-2-0; Den Haag, Memmingen y Firenze bajo CC BY 4.0; Monza e Brianza y Grevenbroich bajo CC0 1.0), fuera de stones.json y de data/search/ (estos dos siguen siendo solo ODbL); el mapa las carga aparte. La API las publica por familia de licencia en api/v1/ (cc-by, cc-by-4, dl-de-zero, dl-de-by, cc0-opendata); la regla de posiblemente vivas se aplica igual (sin indicio de muerte y nacidas hace menos de 110 años, o sin año, no hay ficha). Para datos de personas usa api/v1.

- Do not use this data to harass, to build lists of descendants, for ethnic-religious profiling of living people, for denialism or antisemitic purposes.
- Do not present inferences as facts; point to the primary source. Records can contain errors.
